identityModel: An episode identity is an IETV programme number (original series <1>-<198>, co-production 1-70) or a documented tape title.
archive.org, YouTube and other uploader labels ("עונה N פרק M", "season 6") are broadcast-order or collector labels. They are alternate labels and match evidence, never identities.
Holiday versions of one number (<143> Sukkot, <183> Tu BiShvat) are alternate editions of that number.

Upload roles: whole-candidate (a programme-length upload matched to the number, not verified uncut), alternate-edition, part (a numbered part or an incomplete single file), excerpt (a clip, tape edition or segment), possible (probably this programme, identity unresolved; never counted).
Coverage values: whole-candidate, parts-only, excerpt-only, missing. Possible copies do not change coverage.
Evidence levels are separate from coverage: metadata-checked, playback-started, complete-playback-reviewed, reference-compared.

summary.countingRule: Episode identities are counted once. Upload links, alternate hosts, numbered parts and the holiday versions of <143> and <183> do not add episodes. Possible copies never count as coverage.

method: Start from the NLI IETV numbers, titles, summaries and runtimes (data/nli-ietv-catalogue.json).

Match each archive.org file label (season, slot, story title) to one NLI number inside its season block: by the NLI title, including spelling variants (112 files); by words or phrases of the NLI summary (15); by word 4-gram overlap between the TMDB season-1 synopsis and the NLI summary (36); or by an individual spelling or keyword decision recorded in matchBasis (25).

Runtime agreement (archive.org file length against the NLI runtime) is supporting evidence only. Season-2 and season-3 files are often 50-140 s longer or shorter than the NLI runtimes (rebroadcast or tape edits).

Other uploads attach to a number through an exact or near story title, an uploader label matched through archive.org, a description, the summed length of numbered parts, or YouTube preview frames. The basis is given per upload where the crosswalk recorded it; otherwise it is in the record notes.
An independent spot check of 15 matches reproduced all 15.
